transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I'm coming in today because I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for the past nine months. It's this persistent down mood that I just can't seem to shake off. I really felt like I needed to seek some help for it.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change, or did they come on without a clear trigger? If there was a stressor, is it still going on?

To be honest, I'm not sure of any specific trigger or stressful event that caused this. It really feels like these feelings just came on out of nowhere without any clear reason. There wasn't a major life change or anything like that.
Before these past nine months, had you been feeling down or depressed most days for at least two years, or is this the first time it has lasted this long?
No, I haven't experienced depression lasting for two years prior to this. This current nine-month period is actually the first time it has ever lasted this long.

During these nine months, have you also had symptoms like loss of interest or pleasure, changes in sleep or appetite, low energy, poor concentration, feelings of worthlessness, or thoughts of death or suicide?

Yes, I've completely lost interest and pleasure in the things I used to enjoy, and my appetite has dropped significantly. I also feel constantly exhausted with absolutely no energy to do anything. I haven't really experienced thoughts of worthlessness or suicide, though.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days when you felt unusually energetic or euphoric, needed much less sleep, talked faster, or were more impulsive than usual?

Yes, I actually had a period of about four months where I felt abnormally energetic and euphoric. During that time, I barely needed any sleep but still felt completely refreshed, and I was talking much faster and more than usual.

During that four-month high-energy period, did you have any hallucinations or strongly held beliefs that others said were not true, like feeling especially powerful or chosen? Did those symptoms happen only during that mood episode?
No, I didn't have any hallucinations or beliefs that others found untrue during that period. I never felt unusually powerful or chosen, just very energetic.
During that four-month high-energy period, did your symptoms cause major problems like being hospitalized, getting into serious trouble, or being unable to work or function normally?

No, I don't recall having any problems as severe as being hospitalized or being completely unable to work during that period. I was still able to function and manage my daily life. It never really got to that extreme point.
During that high-energy time, were those symptoms present most of the day nearly every day for at least 4 days in a row?
Yes, absolutely. Those symptoms were there most of the day, nearly every single day. It actually lasted way longer than just four days, continuing pretty much non-stop for about four months.
During that high-energy period, did other people notice you were clearly different from your usual self, even if you were still able to work and manage daily life?

Yes, absolutely, my friends and family definitely noticed a major change in me. They kept pointing out that I was talking incredibly fast, constantly jumping from one thing to another, and seemed unusually energetic, even though I was still managing to get my work done.

Even if you kept working, did that high-energy period lead to clearly risky or harmful behavior, like reckless spending, dangerous sex, reckless driving, or decisions that caused serious consequences?
No, I don't think I engaged in any reckless behaviors like that. I didn't do any wild spending or dangerous driving, and nothing I did during that time caused any serious consequences.
